3508-4879-7666.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a land.
You control a destructible land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3508-4879-7666.description:
Pay {4}{U} to cast Burglar's Plot, exchanging control of a land an opponent controls and Price of Glory.
During an opponent's turn, activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Price of Glory triggers, destroying the land.
Sacred Ground triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4268-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
4268-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

250-779-1479-5226-7885.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-7885.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5226-7885.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

413-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.

5231-6291-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5231-6291-7306.description:

Activate the Mutagen token by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature token.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2034-4871-6000-6005-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

5475-5921-5970-6791.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5414-6529.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1350-2793-4693-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1409-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ultimecia, Omnipotent by paying {1}{U}, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Ultimecia, Time Sorceress trigger, causing you to surveil 2.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Repeat each turn.

1987-2239-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2239-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

5881-5975.notablePrerequisites:
Anzrag does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
5881-5975.description:

Any combat damage dealt to Anzrag will not kill it due to Anara giving it indestructible.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

877-2438-4254-4484.description:

When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

2724-3217-5163.description:

Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.

3525-3784-5115.description:

Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.

1636-3590-4213.notablePrerequisites:
Hankyu attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3590-4213.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the first Hankyu ability by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.

Resolve the Warchanter Skald activated ability, putting an aim counter on Hankyu.
